newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - First Bank raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - First Bank raised.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan securities said it raised First Bank System Inc to buy from market performer
-- Analyst Catherine Murray revises 1997 earnings estimate to $5.00 per share from $5.40, revises 1998 estimate to $6.15 per share from $6.05
-- Analyst says 12-month price target is $89/shr, also says some investors might want wait until after March 25 FOMC meeting to buy stock
-- First Bank System merger with U.S. Bancorp "makes sense for both companies"
